tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. Warm stone by day, near-black by night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The Brief Bar and any floating sheet, with backdrop blur 20px. Only over the hero stage; elsewhere use panel-solid.

tokens.name: panel-solid
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the account column when nothing sits behind them. Same hairline border as panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, panel and tile. 15.6:1 on ground (light), 16.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, group labels, helper text, trailing hints. 4.8:1 on ground (light), 6.9:1 (dark). Never below 13px.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairline separators between rows and the 1px border of panels. Decorative only, so it needs no contrast ratio.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of text fields, checkboxes and unselected chips, where a 3:1 boundary is required.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: The 30px glyph tile that leads every row, and the tile of an empty state. A photo slot with no photo is a scene tile, not this.

tokens.name: tile-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph inside a tile. 6.2:1 on tile (light), 8.4:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The selection accent: the selected glyph tile, a selected chip, progress bars. Fill only; for text on ground use accent-ink. White text on it: 5.1:1 (light), 4.8:1 (dark). Primary buttons and the Top Hit use primary.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the Top Hit row and every primary button; nothing else. Label in on-primary. White on it is 4.9:1 (AA). #ff1414 was asked for and deepened to #e01414 so the 17px label passes; the code uses the same value.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and Top Hit on hover or press.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icons on primary.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, selected row labels, filled slots in the brief sentence. 6.4:1 on ground (light), 11.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Background of a selected result row or creator row. Text on it is accent-ink.

tokens.name: selected-hover
tokens.usage: Selected row on hover or press.

tokens.name: selection-wash
tokens.usage: Behind a filled slot inside the brief sentence, and the hover state of an unselected row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3.9:1 on ground (light), 7.6:1 (dark); always paired with the element's own state change.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Background of a warning or needs-action message (an unconfirmed booking, an expiring code). Text on it is on-attention.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: Text on attention. 9.5:1 (light), 10.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Background of a confirmed or paid state. Text on it is on-success.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success. 7.2:1 (light), 9.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Background of an error message or a cancelled state; also the field border colour on a validation error. Text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger, and the error helper text under a field (6.6:1 on light ground, 9.4:1 on dark).

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: Laid over the hero photograph so the headline and the Brief Bar stay legible in both themes.

tokens.name: sweep-top
tokens.usage: Top of the studio sweep, the first version of the hero stand-in. Kept for the cover and print; the hero now uses the scene colours.

tokens.name: sweep-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the studio sweep.

tokens.name: sweep-key
tokens.usage: The key light: a radial highlight at the top of the sweep.

tokens.name: scene-sky-top
tokens.usage: Top of the scene's sky (landing hero, splash, learning-step stage, confirmed booking). By night it is the ground colour, so the sky runs into the page. Graphic only.

tokens.name: scene-sky-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the scene's sky, at 55 to 60% of its height.

tokens.name: scene-sky-low
tokens.usage: The foot of the scene's sky, behind the edit timeline.

tokens.name: scene-light
tokens.usage: The one light in a scene: the open iris of the lens by day, a low warm opening by night; also its bokeh discs. The centre of the glow that Key light moves.

tokens.name: scene-halo
tokens.usage: The soft halo around scene-light, fading to fully transparent. Never a hard edge.

tokens.name: scene-dune-far
tokens.usage: Name kept from the dune scene. Where the scene is drawn still in CSS (learning-step stage, component previews): the lightest timeline tone. The full SVG scene uses its own lens-* set.

tokens.name: scene-dune-mid
tokens.usage: Name kept from the dune scene. Where the scene is drawn still in CSS: a video clip on the edit timeline.

tokens.name: scene-dune-near
tokens.usage: Name kept from the dune scene. Where the scene is drawn still in CSS: the lower track and the ruler of the edit timeline and, at 16%, its bed. At 50% it is also the low dune on a large scene tile.

tokens.name: scene-tile-top
tokens.usage: Start of the scene tile's gradient (160deg): the stand-in for a photo that does not exist yet. Variants: #e6cdb4 at 200deg and #f1e3d3 at 140deg.

tokens.name: scene-tile-bottom
tokens.usage: End of the scene tile's gradient. Variants: #c0946f and #d0a886.

tokens.name: scene-tile-key
tokens.usage: The highlight on a scene tile: a radial toward the top inline-end corner, fading to transparent at 46%.

tokens.name: scene-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph and text on a scene tile. Light: 5.2:1 on scene-tile-bottom, 4.5:1 on the darkest variant end. Dark: 7.4:1 on scene-tile-top. Keep text in the tile's middle band: 3.1:1 on the low dune, 3.6:1 on the dark highlight.

tokens.name: corner-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the still warm glow behind the top inline-end corner of every screen without a scene; a 400px circle fading to transparent at 68%. Behind content, never over it.

tokens.name: glint-sheen
tokens.usage: Peak of the sheen that crosses the Top Hit in Glint. On nothing else.

tokens.name: pulse-ring
tokens.usage: The ring that spreads from the current step's tile in Pulse, fading to transparent.

tokens.name: whatsapp-ink
tokens.usage: Only for the small text that says a step opens WhatsApp. Not a button colour; the WhatsApp action is the primary Top Hit.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, system-ui, 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Geeza Pro', 'Segoe UI Arabic', sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero line on a phone. One per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page titles below the landing hero: step 2, the directory, a profile name.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings on the bare ground. 30px from 640px.

styles.name: field
styles.sample: I need a photographer for a wedding in Dubai
styles.usage: The brief sentence inside the Brief Bar. 22px from 640px.

styles.name: top-hit
styles.usage: Label of the Top Hit row and primary buttons.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Every result row, creator row and list item. Tabular numerals for prices and dates.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: One fixed price, shown before you book.
styles.usage: Paragraph text on the ground and in messages.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row, timestamps, helper text. Colour mute. Never smaller.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Uppercase group heading above a run of rows. In Arabic: 12px, no letter-spacing, no case change.

styles.name: key-hint
styles.usage: The trailing key hint on a focused row, desktop only.

styles.name: display-ar
styles.usage: The hero line in Arabic: slightly smaller, 25% more leading, no letter-spacing.

styles.name: field-ar
styles.sample: أحتاج مصوّرًا لحفل زفاف في دبي

styles.name: row-ar
styles.usage: Arabic rows. Same 44px row height; the extra leading sits inside it.

styles.name: body-ar
styles.sample: سعر ثابت واحد، تراه قبل الحجز.

styles.name: group-label-ar
styles.usage: Arabic group heading: no uppercase exists, so weight and colour carry it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label inside a chip; icon inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inset of the Top Hit inside the panel; gap between chips; top-hit-inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph tile and the row label; page gutter on a phone (page-gutter).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row inline padding; gap between stacked messages.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 768px; header inline padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its first row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups of rows on the bare ground.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between the headline and the Brief Bar.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section gap on a phone (section-gap); pane gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section gap from 1024px.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Height of every row and every touch target. The whole rhythm of the system.

tokens.name: row-block
tokens.usage: Block padding inside a 44px row around a 30px tile.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: The glyph tile.

tokens.name: photo-tile-size
tokens.usage: The photo tile when the row is a person.

tokens.name: top-hit-height
tokens.usage: The Top Hit row and primary buttons.

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Square size of an icon-only button.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Max width of the Brief Bar and any reading column.

tokens.name: form-column
tokens.usage: Max width of sign-in and booking-details forms.

tokens.name: account-column
tokens.usage: Max width of account lists.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Max width of two-pane layouts (directory list + profile, step 2 list + summary).

tokens.name: radius-key-hint
tokens.usage: Key hints.

tokens.name: radius-message
tokens.usage: Attention, success and danger messages; filled slots in the brief sentence.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Glyph tiles; chips that are not pills.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, text fields, the Top Hit.

tokens.name: radius-photo-tile
tokens.usage: The 44px photo tile.

tokens.name: radius-photo-lg
tokens.usage: Sample tiles and the profile photo.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The Brief Bar, sheets, cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a bottom sheet on a phone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The Brief Bar over the hero stage. The only large shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A bottom sheet on a phone.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Cards on the bare ground (panel-solid). Barely there.

duration.note: Three tiers. React (fast, base, slow) answers the person. Arrive (rise, focus, roll, draw, grow, write, deal, shake) plays once when a thing first appears. Ambient (glint, keylight, settle, drift, pulse) is rationed: see Motion and states for where each may run.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press colour changes, focus ring.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: A row becoming selected, a chip filling, a message appearing.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: A sheet sliding up, a step changing, the sentence slot updating.

tokens.name: duration-rise
tokens.usage: Rise: content enters 14px lower and faded. 420 to 600ms by the size of the thing; 500ms by default.

tokens.name: stagger-step
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings that rise together, the first at 60ms, eight at most.

tokens.name: duration-focus
tokens.usage: Focus: a photo, scene tile or scene enters blurred 10px and 6% large, then sharpens.

tokens.name: duration-roll
tokens.usage: Roll: a price or total rolls up into place. One per screen.

tokens.name: duration-draw
tokens.usage: Tick: the confirmation check draws its stroke.

tokens.name: duration-grow
tokens.usage: Grow: a progress bar fills from its inline start.

tokens.name: duration-write
tokens.usage: Write-in: one slot of the brief sentence being filled.

tokens.name: duration-deal
tokens.usage: Deal: carousel cards slide in from the inline end, 90ms apart.

tokens.name: duration-shake
tokens.usage: Shake: the code boxes, once, on a wrong code.

tokens.name: duration-glint
tokens.usage: Glint: one sheen pass of about 1.1s across the Top Hit in each 7s. Repeats on the landing only; elsewhere one pass on arrival and one each time the Top Hit becomes enabled.

tokens.name: duration-keylight
tokens.usage: Key light: the glow behind the scene's lens breathing out and back. Loops on the landing only.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: Key light on the learning steps and the confirmed booking: the light settles into place once, then still.

tokens.name: duration-drift
tokens.usage: Drift: the landing's creator strip and word ticker, 38 to 54s by length. Pauses on hover, on keyboard focus and with the Pause control.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One beat of Pulse (the current timeline step) or Tap (the learning-step hand). Two beats, then still.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or changes.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Everything that leaves.

tokens.name: ease-ambient
tokens.usage: Key light, Pulse, Tap and the landing's vignettes: slow motion with no arrival.

tokens.name: ease-drift
tokens.usage: Drift only.
